readerCopy.body: A neutral question can sound condescending when it lands on an old place where confidence in one's own voice was already damaged. When Mercury squares Chiron, communication and sensitivity create friction, making corrections, interruptions, delayed replies, or badly chosen phrases carry more insult than the present exchange may contain. The reaction can protect against feeling dismissed while making it harder to discover what was actually meant. The current sentence deserves to be separated from the history it accidentally touched.
